title: Listening, riddles, phrasal verbs and idioms

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: ship

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: ship (ספינה) נשמעת עם i קצרה. sheep (כבשה) עם ee ארוכה.
explanation.en: ship has a short i. sheep has a long ee.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: leave

hints.he: הצליל באמצע המילה קצר או ארוך?
hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: leave (לעזוב) נשמעת עם ee ארוכה. live (לגור) עם i קצרה.
explanation.en: leave has a long ee. live has a short i.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: full

hints.en: Is the u sound short or long?

explanation.he: full (מלא) נשמעת עם u קצרה. fool (טיפש) עם oo ארוכה. בעברית אין הבדל באורך, ולכן צריך להקשיב היטב.
explanation.en: full has a short u. fool has a long oo.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: work

hints.en: Do you hear an r sound?

explanation.he: work (עבודה) נשמעת עם צליל er ו־r. ב־walk (ללכת) ה־l שקטה והתנועה פתוחה, כמו aw.
explanation.en: work has an er sound with r. walk sounds like wawk, the l is silent.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: bed

hints.en: Does the mouth open a lot or a little?

explanation.he: bed (מיטה) נשמעת עם e כמו בעברית. ב־bad (רע) הפה נפתח יותר, צליל בין a ל־e.
explanation.en: bed has a short e. bad has a wider a sound.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: cut

hints.he: הצליל באמצע עמום, או שהפה נפתח לרוחב?
hints.en: Is the middle sound a dull uh, or a wide a?

explanation.he: cut (לחתוך) נשמעת עם צליל קצר כמו "אַ" עמום. ב־cat (חתול) הפה נפתח לרוחב.
explanation.en: cut has a short uh sound. cat has a wide a sound.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: heart

hints.en: Is the vowel long? Is there an r?

explanation.he: heart (לב) נשמעת עם a ארוכה ו־r. hat (כובע) קצרה ובלי r.
explanation.en: heart has a long ar sound. hat is short.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: think

hints.en: Is the tongue between the teeth or behind them?

explanation.he: think (לחשוב) מתחילה ב־th: הלשון יוצאת קצת בין השיניים. sink (כיור) מתחילה ב־s. בעברית אין צליל th, ולכן קל להתבלבל.
explanation.en: think starts with th, the tongue is between the teeth. sink starts with s.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: three

hints.en: Is the first sound soft or hard?

explanation.he: three (שלוש) מתחילה ב־th רכה. tree (עץ) מתחילה ב־t חדה.
explanation.en: three starts with a soft th. tree starts with a hard t.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: mouth

hints.en: Listen to the last sound.

explanation.he: mouth (פה) מסתיימת ב־th. mouse (עכבר) מסתיימת ב־s.
explanation.en: mouth ends in th. mouse ends in s.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: thin

hints.en: Is the first sound soft or hard?

explanation.he: thin (רזה, דק) מתחילה ב־th. tin (פח) מתחילה ב־t.
explanation.en: thin starts with th. tin starts with t.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: west

hints.he: השפתיים נוגעות בשיניים או נעשות עגולות?
hints.en: Do the lips touch the teeth or become round?

explanation.he: west (מערב) מתחילה ב־w: השפתיים עגולות, כמו "וּ". ב־vest (גופייה) השיניים נוגעות בשפה התחתונה.
explanation.en: west starts with w, round lips. vest starts with v, teeth on the lip.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: wine

hints.en: Are the lips round at the start?

explanation.he: wine (יין) מתחילה ב־w עם שפתיים עגולות. vine (גפן) מתחילה ב־v.
explanation.en: wine starts with w. vine starts with v.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: wet

hints.en: Are the lips round at the start?

explanation.he: wet (רטוב) מתחילה ב־w עם שפתיים עגולות. vet (וטרינר) מתחילה ב־v.
explanation.en: wet starts with w. vet starts with v.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: eyes

hints.he: הצליל בסוף מזמזם כמו z או שורק כמו s?
hints.en: Does the end buzz like z or hiss like s?

explanation.he: eyes (עיניים) מסתיימת בצליל z. ice (קרח) מסתיימת בצליל s. ההבדל רק בסוף המילה.
explanation.en: eyes ends with a z sound. ice ends with an s sound.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: wash

hints.en: Is the last sound sh or ch?

explanation.he: wash (לשטוף) מסתיימת ב־sh, כמו ש. watch (לצפות, שעון) מסתיימת ב־ch, כמו צ'.
explanation.en: wash ends in sh. watch ends in ch.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: seat

hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: seat (מושב) נשמעת עם ee ארוכה. sit (לשבת) עם i קצרה.
explanation.en: seat has a long ee. sit has a short i.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: pool

hints.en: Is the u sound short or long?

explanation.he: pool (בריכה) נשמעת עם oo ארוכה. pull (למשוך) עם u קצרה.
explanation.en: pool has a long oo. pull has a short u.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: cup

hints.en: Is the middle sound dull or open?

explanation.he: cup (כוס) נשמעת עם צליל עמום, uh. cap (כובע מצחייה) עם a פתוחה.
explanation.en: cup has a short uh sound. cap has an open a.

items.prompt: Which word did you hear?
items.audioText: heat

hints.en: Is the middle sound short or long?

explanation.he: heat (חום) נשמעת עם ee ארוכה. hit (להכות) עם i קצרה.
explanation.en: heat has a long ee. hit has a short i.

items.prompt: How did the speaker get to school today?
items.audioText: I usually walk to school, but today my dad drove me because it was raining.

hints.en: Listen for what happened today.

explanation.he: usually walk זה מה שקורה בדרך כלל. אבל today my dad drove me: היום אבא הסיע ברכב.
explanation.en: usually = most days. Today my dad drove me, so by car.

items.prompt: When does the ticket office open?
items.audioText: The museum opens at nine, but the ticket office opens half an hour later.

hints.he: half an hour later = חצי שעה אחר כך.
hints.en: half an hour later = 30 minutes after.

explanation.he: המוזיאון נפתח בתשע. הקופה נפתחת חצי שעה אחר כך, כלומר ב־9:30.
explanation.en: Nine plus half an hour is half past nine.

items.prompt: What does the speaker need?
items.audioText: Could you buy some bread on your way home? We have plenty of milk.

hints.en: plenty of = a lot of.

explanation.he: We have plenty of milk אומר שיש מספיק חלב. צריך רק לחם.
explanation.en: There is plenty of milk, so only bread is needed.

items.prompt: Who is the oldest?
items.audioText: My sister is older than me, but my brother is the oldest in the family.

hints.en: Listen for the word oldest.

explanation.he: the oldest = הכי מבוגר. הוא האח.
explanation.en: the oldest = older than everyone. That is the brother.

items.prompt: Why isn't the speaker hungry?
items.audioText: I'm not hungry now. I had a big sandwich an hour ago.

hints.en: an hour ago = sixty minutes before now.

explanation.he: הדובר/ת אכל/ה כריך גדול לפני שעה, ולכן לא רעב/ה.
explanation.en: They had a big sandwich an hour ago.

items.prompt: When did the film start?
items.audioText: The film was supposed to start at eight, but it started twenty minutes late.

hints.he: was supposed to = היה אמור. מה קרה בפועל?
hints.en: was supposed to = the plan. What really happened?

explanation.he: הסרט היה אמור להתחיל בשמונה, אבל התחיל באיחור של 20 דקות: 8:20.
explanation.en: Eight plus twenty minutes late is 8:20.

items.prompt: When can the speaker meet?
items.audioText: I can't come to the party on Friday, but I'm free on Saturday.

hints.en: can't = not able. free = not busy.

explanation.he: I can't come on Friday, but I'm free on Saturday. אפשר להיפגש רק בשבת.
explanation.en: They can't come on Friday but are free on Saturday.

items.prompt: What should students do when they leave?
items.audioText: Please turn off the lights when you leave the classroom.

hints.en: turn off = stop something working.

explanation.he: turn off the lights = לכבות את האורות. turn on = להדליק.
explanation.en: turn off = make the lights stop. turn on = the opposite.

items.prompt: Where did they go?
items.audioText: We wanted to go to the beach, but it was too windy, so we went to the cinema instead.

hints.en: instead = in place of the first plan.

explanation.he: הם רצו ללכת לים, אבל הייתה רוח חזקה. instead: הם הלכו לקולנוע במקום.
explanation.en: They wanted the beach, but went to the cinema instead.

items.prompt: Where is the phone?
items.audioText: My phone is in my bag, not in my pocket.

hints.en: Listen to what comes before not.

explanation.he: in my bag = בתיק. not in my pocket = לא בכיס.
explanation.en: It is in the bag, not in the pocket.

items.prompt: How many pets does Tom have?
items.audioText: Tom has two cats and a dog, and his sister has a rabbit.

hints.en: The rabbit belongs to his sister.

explanation.he: לטום יש שני חתולים וכלב: שלוש חיות. הארנב של אחותו.
explanation.en: Two cats and a dog make three. The rabbit is his sister's.

items.prompt: Why won't they go on Sunday?
items.audioText: The shop is closed on Sundays, so let's go on Monday.

hints.en: Listen to what comes before so.

explanation.he: so = ולכן. הסיבה באה לפניו: החנות סגורה בימי ראשון.
explanation.en: so gives the result. The reason: the shop is closed on Sundays.

items.prompt: Where does the speaker think the keys are?
items.audioText: I've lost my keys again! I think I left them at Dina's house.

hints.en: left them = didn't take them with me.

explanation.he: I left them at Dina's house = השארתי אותם אצל דינה.
explanation.en: They think they left them at Dina's house.

items.prompt: What does the speaker prefer to do tonight?
items.audioText: I'd rather stay at home tonight. I'm really tired after the trip.

hints.he: I'd rather = I would rather = הייתי מעדיף/ה.
hints.en: I'd rather = I would prefer.

explanation.he: I'd rather stay at home = אני מעדיף/ה להישאר בבית. ה־'d הוא קיצור של would.
explanation.en: I'd rather = I would prefer. They want to stay home.

items.prompt: When will they have a picnic?
items.audioText: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we're gonna have a picnic in the park.

options.text: Tomorrow, if the weather is dry

hints.he: gonna = going to. להקשיב לחלק עם if.
hints.en: gonna = going to. Listen to the if part.

explanation.he: If it doesn't rain tomorrow = אם לא ירד גשם מחר. gonna היא דרך מהירה להגיד going to.
explanation.en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, they're going to have a picnic.

items.prompt: Why will the meeting happen again?
items.audioText: Hardly anyone came to the meeting, so we decided to hold it again next week.

hints.en: hardly anyone = almost nobody.

explanation.he: hardly anyone came = כמעט אף אחד לא הגיע. לכן יעשו את הפגישה שוב.
explanation.en: Hardly anyone = almost nobody came, so they will meet again.

items.prompt: Does the speaker play the guitar now?
items.audioText: I used to play the guitar, but I haven't touched it for years.

hints.he: used to = פעם, בעבר, וכבר לא.
hints.en: used to = in the past, not now.

explanation.he: used to play = פעם ניגנתי. haven't touched it for years = לא נגעתי בה שנים.
explanation.en: used to = in the past only. They haven't played for years.

items.prompt: What was the problem?
items.audioText: The train was so crowded that I had to stand the whole way.

hints.en: crowded = full of people.

explanation.he: so crowded that I had to stand = כל כך צפוף שהייתי צריך/ה לעמוד. לא היו מקומות פנויים.
explanation.en: It was so crowded that they had to stand: no free seats.

items.prompt: What does the speaker mean?
items.audioText: You don't need to bring anything. We've already got plenty of food.

options.text: The guest should bring some food.
There is no food in the house.

hints.en: plenty of = more than enough.

explanation.he: You don't need to bring anything = לא צריך להביא כלום, כי כבר יש הרבה אוכל.
explanation.en: No need to bring anything: there is plenty of food.

items.prompt: How does the speaker feel?
items.audioText: I wish I had studied more for the test. I only got a sixty.

hints.he: I wish I had... = הלוואי ש... (על העבר).
hints.en: I wish I had... = regret about the past.

explanation.he: I wish I had studied more = הלוואי שהייתי לומד/ת יותר. זו חרטה. only got a sixty מראה אכזבה.
explanation.en: I wish I had studied shows regret. They are disappointed.

items.prompt: What will happen if you don't hurry?
items.audioText: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the last bus.

options.text: The bus will wait for you.

hints.he: unless = אלא אם כן, אם לא.
hints.en: unless = if not.

explanation.he: unless you hurry = אם לא ממהרים. במקרה כזה מפספסים את האוטובוס האחרון.
explanation.en: unless = if not. If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.

items.prompt: What is true about the new library?
items.audioText: The new library isn't as big as the old one, but it's much brighter.

hints.he: not as big as = לא גדול כמו.
hints.en: not as big as = smaller than.

explanation.he: isn't as big as the old one = קטנה יותר מהישנה. much brighter = הרבה יותר מוארת.
explanation.en: Not as big = smaller. Much brighter = more light.

items.prompt: Why did they take a longer way?
items.audioText: Since the road was closed, we had to take a much longer way home.

options.text: They wanted to see the view.

hints.en: Here since means because.

explanation.he: since יכול לבוא במשמעות because. הכביש היה סגור, ולכן נסעו בדרך ארוכה יותר.
explanation.en: Here since = because. The road was closed.

items.prompt: What does the speaker's mom enjoy?
items.audioText: I'm looking for a present for my mom. She's really into gardening.

hints.he: be into something = לאהוב משהו מאוד.
hints.en: be into something = like it a lot.

explanation.he: She's into gardening = היא מאוד אוהבת גינון.
explanation.en: be into = really like. Mom likes gardening.

items.prompt: What happened?
items.audioText: By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.

hints.he: had already left = כבר יצאה לפני כן.
hints.en: had already left = left before they arrived.

explanation.he: כשהגענו לתחנה, הרכבת כבר יצאה. כלומר פספסנו אותה.
explanation.en: The train left before they arrived, so they missed it.

items.prompt: What does the speaker want?
items.audioText: Would you mind opening the window? It's really hot in here.

hints.he: Would you mind...? = אכפת לך...? בקשה מנומסת.
hints.en: Would you mind...? = a polite request.

explanation.he: Would you mind opening the window = אפשר לפתוח את החלון? חם מאוד בחדר.
explanation.en: It is a polite request to open the window because it's hot.

items.prompt: Did the speaker call?
items.audioText: I'd have called you, but my phone's battery was dead.

hints.he: I'd have called = I would have called: הייתי מתקשר/ת, אבל...
hints.en: I'd have called = I would have called, but...

explanation.he: I'd have called you = הייתי מתקשר/ת אליך. but = אבל זה לא קרה, כי הסוללה נגמרה.
explanation.en: I would have called = it didn't happen, because the battery was dead.

items.prompt: How much did they pay in total?
items.audioText: The concert tickets cost forty shekels each, and we bought three.

hints.en: forty = 40. each = for one ticket.

explanation.he: כרטיס עולה 40 שקלים, וקנו שלושה: 40 כפול 3 = 120. כדאי לשים לב להבדל בין forty (40) ל־fourteen (14).
explanation.en: Forty each times three is 120.

items.prompt: Why doesn't the speaker watch football?
items.audioText: It's not that I don't like football. I just don't have time to watch it.

hints.he: It's not that... = זה לא ש...
hints.en: It's not that... = that is not the reason.

explanation.he: It's not that I don't like football = זה לא שאני לא אוהב/ת כדורגל. הסיבה האמיתית: אין זמן.
explanation.en: The real reason is no time, not dislike.

items.prompt: What will the weather be like this afternoon?
items.audioText: Make sure you take an umbrella. They say it's going to pour this afternoon.

hints.en: pour = come down a lot. Why an umbrella?

explanation.he: it's going to pour = יירד גשם חזק מאוד. לכן צריך מטרייה.
explanation.en: pour = rain very hard. Take an umbrella.

items.prompt: Why isn't Maya going to the game?
items.audioText: Dan: Are you coming to the game tonight? Maya: I can't, I have to finish my project.

hints.he: להקשיב למה שמאיה אומרת אחרי I can't.
hints.en: Listen to what Maya says after I can't.

explanation.he: מאיה אומרת I have to finish my project: היא צריכה לסיים פרויקט.
explanation.en: Maya has to finish her project.

items.prompt: What does Lior think about the soup?
items.audioText: Lior: This soup is a bit salty, isn't it? Mom: Is it? I'll add some water next time.

hints.en: salty comes from salt.

explanation.he: salty = מלוח. ליאור חושב שיש במרק יותר מדי מלח. לכן אמא תוסיף מים בפעם הבאה.
explanation.en: salty = too much salt.

items.prompt: Whose bike will Amit use?
items.audioText: Dina: Do you want to borrow my bike? Amit: Thanks, but my brother is lending me his.

hints.en: his = belonging to him. Who is he?

explanation.he: עמית אומר my brother is lending me his: אחיו משאיל לו את האופניים שלו. לכן הוא לא צריך את של דינה.
explanation.en: Amit's brother is lending him his bike.

items.prompt: What is Yoni's problem?
items.audioText: Teacher: Where's your homework, Yoni? Yoni: I did it, honestly, but I left it on the kitchen table.

options.text: He left his homework at home.
He lost his homework on the bus.

hints.he: I did it = עשיתי. אז מה הבעיה?
hints.en: I did it = it's done. So what is the problem?

explanation.he: יוני עשה את שיעורי הבית, אבל השאיר אותם על שולחן המטבח בבית.
explanation.en: He did it but left it on the kitchen table.

items.prompt: What was bad about the pizza place?
items.audioText: Shira: How was the new pizza place? Ben: The pizza was great, but we waited almost an hour for it.

hints.en: Listen to what comes after but.

explanation.he: הפיצה הייתה מעולה, אבל חיכו כמעט שעה. הבעיה היא השירות האיטי.
explanation.en: The pizza was great, but they waited almost an hour.

items.prompt: What is Eden hinting?
items.audioText: Gal: Should I wear my jacket? Eden: Well, the forecast said it would warm up, but you know how wrong they can be.

options.text: Taking the jacket is a good idea.
It will definitely be warm today.
Gal should just stay at home.

hints.en: Eden doesn't trust the forecast.

explanation.he: עדן אומרת שהתחזיות טועות הרבה. כלומר, בלי להגיד ישירות: כדאי לקחת מעיל.
explanation.en: Eden suggests the forecast may be wrong, so the jacket is a good idea.

items.prompt: What does Tamar mean?
items.audioText: Ron: I've been practicing this song for weeks. Tamar: And it shows! You hardly made any mistakes.

options.text: Ron made a lot of mistakes.

hints.he: it shows = רואים את זה. hardly any = כמעט אין.
hints.en: it shows = we can see it. hardly any = almost none.

explanation.he: And it shows = ורואים את זה. hardly made any mistakes = כמעט לא טעית. זו מחמאה.
explanation.en: It shows = the practice is clear. Almost no mistakes: a compliment.

items.prompt: What can the customer do?
items.audioText: Customer: Excuse me, do you have this shirt in a larger size? Assistant: Sorry, that's the last one, but we're getting more on Thursday.

hints.he: that's the last one = זה האחרון.
hints.en: that's the last one = there are no more now.

explanation.he: אין עכשיו מידה גדולה יותר, אבל ביום חמישי יגיעו עוד חולצות.
explanation.en: There are no larger sizes now, but more are coming on Thursday.

items.prompt: How does Omer feel?
items.audioText: Maya: Did you hear that the trip was cancelled? Omer: You're kidding! I've been looking forward to it all month.

hints.he: looking forward to = מחכה בקוצר רוח.
hints.en: looking forward to = waiting happily for.

explanation.he: עומר חיכה לטיול כל החודש, ועכשיו הוא בוטל. You're kidding מראה הפתעה ואכזבה.
explanation.en: He was looking forward to the trip, so he is disappointed.

items.prompt: What does Tom do?
items.audioText: Adi: Can you help me move the sofa on Sunday? Tom: Sunday's tricky. How about Monday evening?

options.text: He agrees to help on Sunday.
He refuses to help at all.

hints.en: How about...? = an offer of another option.

explanation.he: Sunday's tricky = יום ראשון קשה לי. How about Monday evening = הצעה ליום אחר.
explanation.en: Sunday is difficult, so he suggests Monday.

items.prompt: What can we understand about Eli?
items.audioText: Dana: You look exhausted. Eli: I was up till three finishing my essay. Dana: Again? Maybe start earlier next time.

hints.en: What does Dana's word Again? tell us?

explanation.he: Again? = שוב? דנה מופתעת כי זה כבר קרה בעבר. אלי נוטה לסיים עבודות ברגע האחרון.
explanation.en: Again? shows it has happened before.

items.prompt: Which time will the patient probably choose?
items.audioText: Receptionist: The doctor can see you at four or at six. Patient: Four is a bit early. I finish school at half past four.

hints.en: When does the patient finish school?

explanation.he: ארבע מוקדם מדי, כי הלימודים נגמרים ב־4:30. לכן כנראה יבחרו בשש.
explanation.en: Four is too early, so six is the likely choice.

items.prompt: Why does Michal want to join the drama club?
items.audioText: Michal: I'm thinking of joining the drama club. Noam: You? You hate standing in front of people! Michal: That's exactly why. I want to get over it.

options.text: To stop being afraid of performing
Because she loves being on stage

hints.en: get over = stop being affected by.

explanation.he: מיכל שונאת לעמוד מול אנשים, ודווקא בגלל זה רוצה להצטרף: כדי להתגבר על הפחד.
explanation.en: She hates it, and wants to get over it.

items.prompt: What does Rotem think of the book?
items.audioText: Itay: Did you finish the book I lent you? Rotem: I'm halfway through. To be honest, it's a bit slow.

options.text: It's the best book she's read.

hints.en: A slow book = not much happens.

explanation.he: To be honest, it's a bit slow = האמת, הוא קצת איטי. כלומר לא מרתק במיוחד.
explanation.en: A bit slow = not very exciting.

items.prompt: What does Lia want?
items.audioText: Waiter: Would you like anything else? Lia: No, thanks. Just the bill, please.

hints.en: the bill = the paper that says how much to pay.

explanation.he: Just the bill, please = רק את החשבון, בבקשה. ליה רוצה לשלם.
explanation.en: She asks for the bill, so she wants to pay.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: because

feedback.he: הצליל au נכתב כאן au: because.
feedback.en: The sound is spelled au: because.
The order is c-a-u-s-e.

hints.en: It starts with be.

hints.he: אחרי be באה מילה שפירושה סיבה.
hints.en: After be comes a word that means reason.

explanation.he: because = כי, בגלל ש. אפשר לזכור: be + cause (סיבה).
explanation.en: because = be + cause.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: friend

feedback.en: In friend, i comes before e.
There is a silent i: fri-end.

hints.en: 6 letters.
The word ends with end.

explanation.he: friend = חבר/ה. טריק: a friend is there to the end. המילה נגמרת ב־end.
explanation.en: friend ends with end: a friend to the end.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: necessary

feedback.he: יש רק c אחת ושתי s.
feedback.en: One c, two s.
You need two s in the middle.

hints.en: one c, double s.
The ending is spelled ary.

explanation.he: necessary = הכרחי. טריק: one Collar, two Sleeves: c אחת ושתי s.
explanation.en: necessary: one c (collar), two s (sleeves).

items.prompt: Type the question word you hear.
items.audioText: which

feedback.en: There is a silent h after w.

feedback.he: witch = מכשפה. מילת השאלה היא which.
feedback.en: witch is a person who does magic. The question word is which.

hints.en: It starts with wh, like what.
5 letters.

explanation.he: which = איזה. כמו רוב מילות השאלה, מתחילה ב־wh. witch נשמעת אותו דבר אבל פירושה מכשפה.
explanation.en: which = question word, starts with wh. witch sounds the same.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: believe

feedback.en: Here i comes before e: bel-ie-ve.

hints.en: There is lie in the middle.

explanation.he: believe = להאמין. טריק: never believe a lie. יש lie באמצע המילה.
explanation.en: Never believe a lie: lie is inside believe.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: different

feedback.en: There is an e you hardly hear: diff-e-rent.
You need two f.

hints.en: double f.

hints.he: אחרי ה־ff יש e שכמעט לא שומעים.
hints.en: After the ff there is an e you can hardly hear.

explanation.he: different = שונה. שתי f, ואחריהן e שכמעט לא שומעים.
explanation.en: different: double f, and a quiet e.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: business

feedback.en: u comes first: b-u-s-i.
One s at the start, two at the end.

hints.en: It starts with bus.
After bus there is a quiet i.

explanation.he: business = עסק. טריק: bus + i + ness. ה־i באמצע כמעט לא נשמעת.
explanation.en: business = bus + i + ness.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: receive

feedback.en: After c we write ei: rec-ei-ve.

hints.he: i before e, except after c.
hints.en: i before e, except after c.

explanation.he: receive = לקבל. הכלל: i before e, except after c. אחרי c כותבים ei.
explanation.en: i before e, except after c: receive.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: separate

feedback.en: There is an a in the middle: sep-a-rate.

hints.en: There is a rat in it.

explanation.he: separate = נפרד, להפריד. טריק: there is a rat in separate.
explanation.en: There is a rat in separate.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: Wednesday

feedback.en: There is a silent d: Wed-nes-day.
There is a silent d: Wed-nes-day.

hints.en: A day of the week.

hints.he: יש בה d שלא שומעים, קרוב להתחלה.
hints.en: There is a d you don't hear near the start.

explanation.he: Wednesday = יום רביעי. כותבים Wed-nes-day, אבל אומרים wenz-day. ה־d הראשונה שקטה.
explanation.en: Wednesday is said wenz-day. The first d is silent.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: library

feedback.he: יש r גם אחרי ה־b: lib-r-ary.
feedback.en: There is an r after b too: lib-r-ary.
The word ends with ary.

hints.en: two r.
There is an r right after the b.

explanation.he: library = ספרייה. יש בה שתי r: lib-r-a-r-y.
explanation.en: library has two r: lib-r-a-r-y.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: address

feedback.en: You need two d.
You need two s at the end.

hints.en: two double letters.
The double letters are d and s.

explanation.he: address = כתובת. יש שתי אותיות כפולות: dd ו־ss.
explanation.en: address has double d and double s.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: definitely

feedback.en: There is no a: def-i-nite-ly.

feedback.he: צריך e לפני ly: definite + ly.
feedback.en: Keep the e: definite + ly.

hints.en: finite is inside it.
There is no letter a in it.

explanation.he: definitely = בהחלט. בונים אותה מ־definite (מוגדר) + ly. אין a במילה.
explanation.en: definitely = definite + ly. No a.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: knowledge

feedback.he: יש k שקטה בהתחלה, כמו know.
feedback.en: There is a silent k, like in know.
There is a d before ge: know-ledge.

hints.en: It starts like know.

hints.he: יש d לפני ה־g, כמו ב־edge.
hints.en: There is a d before the g, like in edge.

explanation.he: knowledge = ידע. know + ledge. ה־k בהתחלה שקטה.
explanation.en: knowledge = know + ledge. The k is silent.

items.prompt: Type the word you hear.
items.audioText: interesting

feedback.en: There is a quiet e: int-e-rest-ing.

hints.en: rest is inside it.

hints.he: יש e אחרי ה־t הראשונה, גם אם לא שומעים אותה.
hints.en: There is an e after the first t, even if you don't hear it.

explanation.he: interesting = מעניין. אומרים לפעמים intresting, אבל כותבים inter-est-ing.
explanation.en: We often say intresting, but write inter-est-ing.

items.prompt: What has keys but can't open locks?

hints.en: keys can also be the parts you press to play music.

explanation.he: key = מפתח, וגם קליד. לפסנתר יש keys (קלידים), אבל הם לא פותחים מנעולים.
explanation.en: A piano has keys you press, but they can't open locks.

items.prompt: What has hands but can't clap?

hints.en: hands can also point to the time.

explanation.he: hands = ידיים, וגם מחוגים של שעון. לשעון יש מחוגים, אבל הוא לא יכול למחוא כפיים.
explanation.en: A clock has hands that show the time, but it can't clap.

items.prompt: What has a neck but no head?

hints.he: neck = צוואר. איזה חפץ יש לו צוואר?
hints.en: Which object has a neck?

explanation.he: לבקבוק יש neck (צוואר הבקבוק), אבל אין לו ראש. לג'ירפה יש גם צוואר וגם ראש.
explanation.en: A bottle has a neck, but no head. A giraffe has both.

items.prompt: What gets wetter the more it dries?

hints.en: What dries you after a shower?

explanation.he: מגבת מייבשת אותנו, וככל שהיא מייבשת יותר, היא נעשית רטובה יותר. הטריק: dries כאן = מייבשת משהו אחר.
explanation.en: A towel dries you and gets wetter. Here dries means dries something else.

items.prompt: What has many teeth but can't bite?

hints.en: You use it on your hair.

explanation.he: comb = מסרק. יש לו teeth (שיניים), אבל הוא לא נושך. לכריש יש שיניים והוא נושך.
explanation.en: A comb has teeth but can't bite. A shark can bite.

items.prompt: What can you catch but not throw?

hints.en: catch a cold = become ill with a cold.

explanation.he: catch = לתפוס, וגם "לחטוף" מחלה. catch a cold = להצטנן. כדור ודג אפשר גם לזרוק.
explanation.en: You catch a cold, but you can't throw it. A ball and a fish can be thrown.

items.prompt: What goes up but never comes down?

hints.en: It happens to all of us every year.

explanation.he: הגיל שלנו רק עולה ואף פעם לא יורד. כדור ומטוס עולים וגם יורדים.
explanation.en: Your age only goes up. A ball and a plane come down.

items.prompt: What has one eye but can't see?

hints.he: eye הוא גם החור שמכניסים בו חוט.
hints.en: eye can be the hole for a thread.

explanation.he: eye of a needle = חור המחט, שמכניסים בו חוט. למחט יש eye אחת והיא לא רואה.
explanation.en: The eye of a needle is the hole for the thread.

items.prompt: What has four legs but can't walk?

hints.en: It is a piece of furniture.

explanation.he: לשולחן יש legs (רגליים), אבל הוא לא הולך. כלב וסוס הולכים.
explanation.en: A table has legs but can't walk.

items.prompt: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?

hints.en: take a step = walk one step.

explanation.he: take a step = לעשות צעד. כל צעד משאיר עקבה מאחור. footsteps = עקבות, צעדים.
explanation.en: Every step you take leaves a footstep behind.

items.prompt: What is full of holes but still holds water?

hints.en: You use it to wash dishes.

explanation.he: ספוג מלא חורים, ועדיין סופג ומחזיק מים. לכוס ולדלי אין חורים.
explanation.en: A sponge is full of holes and holds water.

items.prompt: What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?

hints.he: מדביקים את זה בפינה של מכתב.
hints.en: You stick it in the corner of a letter.

explanation.he: בול נשאר בפינה של המעטפה, אבל המכתב נוסע איתו לכל העולם.
explanation.en: A stamp stays in the corner of an envelope and travels everywhere.

items.prompt: What has words but never speaks?

hints.en: You read it.

explanation.he: בספר יש מילים, אבל הוא לא מדבר. תוכי ורדיו משמיעים מילים.
explanation.en: A book has words but makes no sound.

items.prompt: What runs but never walks, and has a mouth but never talks?

hints.he: mouth הוא גם המקום שבו נהר פוגש את הים.
hints.en: A mouth can be where water meets the sea.

explanation.he: נהר זורם (runs) ויש לו mouth (שפך). אבל הוא לא הולך ולא מדבר.
explanation.en: A river runs, and it has a mouth where it meets the sea.

items.prompt: What has a head and a tail but no body?

hints.he: heads or tails? מטילים את זה באוויר.
hints.en: Heads or tails? You flip it.

explanation.he: heads or tails = עץ או פלי. לכל מטבע יש head ו־tail, אבל אין לו גוף.
explanation.en: A coin has heads and tails, but no body.

items.prompt: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?

hints.en: Others call you with it.

explanation.he: השם שלנו שייך לנו, אבל אחרים אומרים אותו הרבה יותר מאיתנו.
explanation.en: Other people say your name more than you do.

items.prompt: Some months have 31 days. How many months have 28 days?

hints.en: Does every month have at least 28 days?

explanation.he: הטריק: בכל החודשים יש 28 ימים, וגם יותר. כולם, לא רק פברואר.
explanation.en: Every month has at least 28 days, so all twelve.

items.prompt: Which word is always spelled wrong in the dictionary?

hints.en: Read the question word by word.

explanation.he: המילה wrong תמיד מאויתת w-r-o-n-g. כלומר, היא תמיד כתובה "wrong".
explanation.en: The word wrong is always spelled w-r-o-n-g.

items.prompt: What starts with E, ends with E and has only one letter in it?

hints.en: letter = a, b, c... or a message on paper.

explanation.he: letter = אות, וגם מכתב. envelope (מעטפה) מתחילה ונגמרת ב־e, ויש בה מכתב אחד.
explanation.en: An envelope starts and ends with e, and has one letter (message) inside.

items.prompt: Which building has the most stories?

hints.en: story = a tale, or a floor of a building.

explanation.he: story = סיפור, וגם קומה בבניין. בספרייה יש הכי הרבה סיפורים.
explanation.en: A library has the most stories (tales).

items.prompt: What can you break without touching it?

hints.en: break a promise = not do what you said.

explanation.he: break a promise = להפר הבטחה. לא צריך לגעת בה כדי לשבור אותה. כוס וביצה צריך לגעת.
explanation.en: You break a promise without touching anything.

items.prompt: What is always in front of you but can't be seen?

hints.en: It is time, not a thing.

explanation.he: העתיד תמיד "לפנינו", אבל אי אפשר לראות אותו. את הידיים ואת הכביש אפשר לראות.
explanation.en: The future is ahead of you, but you can't see it.

items.prompt: I'm tall when I'm young, and I'm short when I'm old. What am I?

hints.en: It burns and gets shorter.

explanation.he: נר חדש ארוך, וככל שהוא דולק הוא נעשה קצר יותר. עץ ואדם גדלים, לא מתקצרים.
explanation.en: A candle gets shorter as it burns.

items.prompt: What has a thumb and four fingers but isn't alive?

hints.en: You wear it in winter.

explanation.he: לכפפה יש מקום לאגודל ולארבע אצבעות, אבל היא לא חיה. יד היא חלק מגוף חי.
explanation.en: A glove has a thumb and fingers but isn't alive.

items.prompt: What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?

hints.en: Look at the letters in the words.

explanation.he: ב־minute יש m אחת, ב־moment שתיים, וב־a thousand years אין m בכלל.
explanation.en: minute has one m, moment has two, a thousand years has none.

items.prompt: What has to be broken before you can use it?

hints.en: You use it to make an omelet.

explanation.he: ביצה צריך לשבור לפני שמשתמשים בה. חלון ומפתח לא צריך לשבור.
explanation.en: You must break an egg to use it.

items.prompt: Which question can you never answer "yes" to?

hints.en: A sleeping person doesn't answer.

explanation.he: asleep = ישן/ה. מי שישן באמת לא יכול לענות "yes". אם עונים, סימן שלא ישנים.
explanation.en: If you are asleep, you can't say yes.

items.prompt: Forward I am heavy, but backward I am not. What am I?

hints.en: Read a word backwards.

explanation.he: ton = טון, משקל כבד. מהסוף להתחלה זה not = לא. כלומר backward I am "not".
explanation.en: ton is heavy. Backwards it is not.

items.prompt: What gets bigger the more you take away from it?

hints.en: You dig it in the ground.

explanation.he: hole = בור, חור. כל מה שמוציאים ממנו הופך אותו לגדול יותר. פיצה וערימת חול רק קטנות.
explanation.en: The more you dig out of a hole, the bigger it gets.

items.prompt: What kind of room has no doors or windows?

hints.he: מילה שנגמרת ב־room אבל היא לא חדר.
hints.en: A word ending in room that isn't a room.

explanation.he: mushroom = פטרייה. המילה נגמרת ב־room, אבל זה בכלל לא חדר.
explanation.en: A mushroom ends in room, but it is not a room.

items.prompt: Don't ___ now! You're almost at the top of the mountain.

hints.he: מה אומרים למישהו שרוצה להפסיק לנסות?
hints.en: What do we say to someone who wants to stop trying?

explanation.he: give up = לוותר, להפסיק לנסות. give away = לתת במתנה. give back = להחזיר.
explanation.en: give up = stop trying. give away = give for free. give back = return.

items.audioText: Don't give up now! You're almost at the top of the mountain.

items.prompt: Can you ___ my dog while I'm on holiday?

hints.en: Someone needs to take care of the dog.

explanation.he: look after = לשמור על, לטפל ב. look for = לחפש. look up = לחפש מידע.
explanation.en: look after = take care of. look for = search.

items.audioText: Can you look after my dog while I'm on holiday?

items.prompt: "I want to find out what time the shop closes." What does "find out" mean here?

hints.en: What do you want to know?

explanation.he: find out = לגלות, לברר מידע. לא קשור ל־out = בחוץ.
explanation.en: find out = learn a fact you didn't know.

items.prompt: She ___ the job offer because the salary was too low.

hints.he: המשכורת נמוכה. היא קיבלה את ההצעה?
hints.en: The salary was low. Did she accept?

explanation.he: turn down an offer = לסרב להצעה. turn up = להגיע, להגביר. turn on = להדליק.
explanation.en: turn down = say no to. turn up = arrive. turn on = switch on.

items.audioText: She turned down the job offer because the salary was too low.

items.prompt: "We had to put off the trip until next month." What does "put off" mean?

hints.he: until next month = עד החודש הבא.
hints.en: until next month = it will happen later.

explanation.he: put off = לדחות למועד אחר. הטיול עדיין יקרה, רק בחודש הבא, ולכן לא ביטול.
explanation.en: put off = move to a later time. It's not cancelled.

items.prompt: We've ___ milk. Can you buy some on your way home?

hints.en: Why do they need to buy milk?

explanation.he: run out of = שנגמר משהו. נגמר החלב, ולכן צריך לקנות. run into = לפגוש במקרה.
explanation.en: run out of = have none left.

items.audioText: We've run out of milk. Can you buy some on your way home?

items.prompt: "She came up with a great idea for the project." What does "came up with" mean?

hints.en: Where does an idea come from?

explanation.he: come up with = להמציא, לחשוב על רעיון. לא קשור לטיפוס למעלה.
explanation.en: come up with = think of an idea or plan.

items.prompt: I ___ my classmates. We never argue.

hints.he: We never argue = אף פעם לא רבים.
hints.en: We never argue = no fights.

explanation.he: get along with = להסתדר עם. get over = להתגבר על. get away with = לצאת בלי עונש.
explanation.en: get along with = have a good relationship with.

items.audioText: I get along with my classmates. We never argue.

items.prompt: I'm really ___ the summer holidays.

hints.en: How do you feel before the holidays?

explanation.he: look forward to = לחכות בקוצר רוח, לצפות בשמחה למשהו. אחרי to בא שם עצם או ing.
explanation.en: look forward to = wait happily for. After it: a noun or -ing.

items.audioText: I'm really looking forward to the summer holidays.

items.prompt: "Our plane took off at six in the morning." What does "took off" mean?

hints.en: What does a plane do at the start of a flight?

explanation.he: take off (מטוס) = להמריא. land = לנחות. take off גם אומר להוריד בגד.
explanation.en: take off (plane) = leave the ground. The opposite is land.

items.prompt: "Two friends set up a small business selling cakes." What does "set up" mean?

hints.en: A new business.

explanation.he: set up a business = להקים עסק.
explanation.en: set up = start or create something.

items.prompt: Sorry for interrupting. Please ___ with your story.

hints.he: מישהו הפריע באמצע הסיפור. מה מבקשים מהמספר/ת לעשות?
hints.en: Someone interrupted the story. What do we ask the storyteller to do?

explanation.he: carry on = להמשיך. carry out = לבצע (משימה, ניסוי).
explanation.en: carry on = continue. carry out = do a task.

items.audioText: Sorry for interrupting. Please carry on with your story.

items.prompt: Our car ___ on the way to Eilat, so we called for help.

hints.en: Why did they need help?

explanation.he: break down = להתקלקל (רכב, מכונה). break up = להיפרד. break out = לפרוץ (מלחמה, שריפה).
explanation.en: break down = stop working. break up = end a relationship.

items.audioText: Our car broke down on the way to Eilat, so we called for help.

items.prompt: "She was brought up by her grandparents." What does "brought up" mean?

hints.en: Who took care of her as a child?

explanation.he: bring up a child = לגדל ילד. לא קשור להעלות למעלה.
explanation.en: bring up = raise a child.

items.prompt: I can't ___ how this new app works.

hints.en: understand something after thinking.

explanation.he: figure out = להבין, לפענח. give out = לחלק. put out = לכבות.
explanation.en: figure out = understand after thinking.

items.audioText: I can't figure out how this new app works.

items.prompt: "Only five people showed up to the meeting." What does "showed up" mean?

hints.en: How many people were at the meeting?

explanation.he: show up = להגיע, להופיע. רק חמישה אנשים הגיעו.
explanation.en: show up = arrive, come.

items.prompt: Can you ___ my little brother from school today?

hints.en: collect someone by car.

explanation.he: pick up = לאסוף (מישהו או משהו). pick out = לבחור.
explanation.en: pick up = collect. pick out = choose.

items.audioText: Can you pick up my little brother from school today?

items.prompt: "If you don't know a word, look it up in the dictionary." What does "look up" mean?

hints.en: What do you do with a dictionary?

explanation.he: look up a word = לחפש מילה במילון או ברשת.
explanation.en: look up = search for information.

items.prompt: "It took her two weeks to get over the flu." What does "get over" mean?

hints.en: Two weeks after getting sick, what happened?

explanation.he: get over an illness = להחלים ממחלה. get over גם = להתגבר על משהו.
explanation.en: get over = recover from.

items.prompt: The doctor told him to ___ sugar.

hints.en: A doctor says eat less.

explanation.he: cut down on = להפחית. cut up = לחתוך לחתיכות. cut in = להתפרץ לשיחה.
explanation.en: cut down on = have less of.

items.audioText: The doctor told him to cut down on sugar.

items.prompt: "He made up a story about a dragon to explain why he was late." What does "made up" mean?

hints.en: A real dragon? Probably not.

explanation.he: make up a story = להמציא סיפור. הוא לא אמר את האמת.
explanation.en: make up = invent, often something not true.

items.prompt: The match was ___ because of the storm.

hints.en: A storm. Did the match happen?

explanation.he: call off = לבטל. call back = להתקשר בחזרה. call up = להתקשר, לגייס.
explanation.en: call off = cancel.

items.audioText: The match was called off because of the storm.

items.prompt: Students must ___ their essays to the teacher by Friday.

hints.en: Students give to the teacher.

explanation.he: hand in = להגיש (עבודה). hand out = לחלק. המורה עושה hand out, התלמידים עושים hand in.
explanation.en: hand in = give work to a teacher. hand out = give to many people.

items.audioText: Students must hand in their essays to the teacher by Friday.

items.prompt: "The police are looking into the robbery." What does "looking into" mean?

hints.en: What do the police do after a robbery?

explanation.he: look into = לחקור, לבדוק לעומק.
explanation.en: look into = investigate.

items.prompt: "I work out at the gym three times a week." What does "work out" mean here?

hints.en: What do you do at the gym?

explanation.he: work out = להתאמן. ל־work out יש גם משמעות של לפתור בעיה, אבל at the gym מראה שמדובר באימון.
explanation.en: work out at the gym = exercise.

items.prompt: "Don't worry about the test. It's a piece of cake." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: Don't worry = no problem.

explanation.he: a piece of cake = קל מאוד, בעברית "קלי קלות" או "קטן עליי".
explanation.en: a piece of cake = very easy.

items.prompt: "At the start of the party, Dan told a joke to break the ice." Why did Dan tell a joke?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: To help people relax and talk
To make the room feel colder
To show the party was over

hints.en: The start of a party, people don't know each other.

explanation.he: break the ice = לשבור את הקרח. בדיוק כמו בעברית: להפיג מבוכה בתחילת מפגש.
explanation.en: break the ice = make people feel relaxed. Hebrew has the same idiom.

items.prompt: "I'm a bit under the weather today, so I'll stay home." How does the speaker feel?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: Why stay at home?

explanation.he: under the weather = לא מרגיש/ה טוב, "לא בקו הבריאות".
explanation.en: under the weather = a little ill.

items.prompt: "I love this phone, but it costs an arm and a leg." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: but = there's a problem.

explanation.he: cost an arm and a leg = עולה הון תועפות, יקר מאוד.
explanation.en: costs an arm and a leg = very expensive.

items.prompt: "The exam is on Monday, so this weekend I have to hit the books." What will the speaker do?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: What do you do before an exam?

explanation.he: hit the books = ללמוד הרבה, "לשבת על הספרים".
explanation.en: hit the books = study hard.

items.prompt: "We only eat out once in a blue moon." How often do they eat out?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.he: once = פעם אחת. blue moon לא קורה הרבה.
hints.en: once = one time. A blue moon is rare.

explanation.he: once in a blue moon = לעיתים רחוקות מאוד. בעברית: "אחת ליובל".
explanation.en: once in a blue moon = very rarely.

items.prompt: "It was a surprise party, but my little brother spilled the beans." What did the brother do?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.he: מסיבת הפתעה. מה יכול להרוס אותה?
hints.en: A surprise party. What could ruin it?

explanation.he: spill the beans = לגלות סוד, "לפלוט".
explanation.en: spill the beans = tell a secret.

items.prompt: "I've said sorry three times. Now the ball is in your court." What does the speaker mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: Whose turn is it?

explanation.he: the ball is in your court = הכדור אצלך, עכשיו תורך להחליט או לפעול.
explanation.en: The ball is in your court = now it's your decision.

items.prompt: "When she got the scholarship, she was on cloud nine." How did she feel?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: A scholarship is good news.

explanation.he: on cloud nine = מאושר/ת מאוד. בעברית: "ברקיע השביעי".
explanation.en: on cloud nine = extremely happy.

items.prompt: "My brother will clean his room when pigs fly." What does the speaker think?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: He will clean it with animals.

hints.en: Can pigs fly?

explanation.he: when pigs fly = אף פעם. בעברית: "כשיצמחו לי שערות על כף היד".
explanation.en: when pigs fly = never.

items.prompt: "Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise: I met my best friend while waiting for the next one." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: Something bad that led to something good
A nice present wrapped in paper

hints.en: What happened in the end?

explanation.he: a blessing in disguise = ברכה בתחפושת, "גם זו לטובה". משהו רע שהוביל לטוב.
explanation.en: a blessing in disguise = a bad thing that turns out good.

items.prompt: "We've been working for ten hours. Let's call it a day." What does the speaker suggest?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.he: עשר שעות עבודה. מה רוצים לעשות?
hints.en: Ten hours of work. What do they want?

explanation.he: call it a day = לסיים להיום.
explanation.en: call it a day = stop for today.

items.prompt: "He wanted to sing at the show, but he got cold feet." What happened?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: He became too nervous to do it.
His feet felt cold on stage.

hints.en: but = something changed.

explanation.he: get cold feet = להילחץ ולהתחרט ברגע האחרון.
explanation.en: get cold feet = become too nervous to do something.

items.prompt: "If Mom sees this mess, we'll be in hot water." What does the speaker mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: Mom sees a mess.

explanation.he: be in hot water = להיות בצרות.
explanation.en: in hot water = in trouble.

items.prompt: "Can you keep an eye on my bag while I buy a drink?" What is the speaker asking?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: To put something in the bag

hints.en: Why does the bag need help?

explanation.he: keep an eye on = לשמור על, להשגיח. בעברית: "לפקוח עין".
explanation.en: keep an eye on = watch carefully.

items.prompt: "Did you really meet the president, or are you pulling my leg?" What does the speaker think?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: The other person may be joking.

hints.en: really? = is it true?

explanation.he: pull someone's leg = לעבוד על מישהו בצחוק, "לסובב".
explanation.en: pull someone's leg = joke, tell something untrue for fun.

items.prompt: "My sister and I don't see eye to eye about music." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: don't = not.

explanation.he: see eye to eye = להסכים, לראות עין בעין. כמו בעברית. כאן יש don't, כלומר אין הסכמה.
explanation.en: see eye to eye = agree. They don't agree.

items.prompt: "You can't sit on the fence forever. Which team do you support?" What does "sit on the fence" mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: Which team? = choose one.

explanation.he: sit on the fence = לשבת על הגדר, לא לבחור צד. כמו בעברית.
explanation.en: sit on the fence = not decide between two sides.

items.prompt: "He was late every day, and when he lost the keys, that was the last straw." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: The last drink in the glass

hints.en: Many problems, and then one more.

explanation.he: the last straw = הקש ששבר את גב הגמל. הבעיה האחרונה שאחריה כבר אין סבלנות.
explanation.en: the last straw = one more problem after many, and now it is too much.

items.prompt: "I know all the words of this song by heart." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: I can say them without looking.
I wrote all of them myself.

hints.en: know a song without paper.

explanation.he: know by heart = לדעת בעל פה.
explanation.en: by heart = from memory.

items.prompt: "You hit the nail on the head: the real problem is that we don't have enough time." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: You said exactly the right thing.
You fixed something with a hammer.

hints.en: the real problem = the true reason.

explanation.he: hit the nail on the head = לקלוע בדיוק, "בול".
explanation.en: hit the nail on the head = be exactly right.

items.prompt: "I walk to work, so I kill two birds with one stone: I exercise and save money." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: Doing two things with one action
Wasting time on a long walk

hints.en: How many good things come from walking?

explanation.he: kill two birds with one stone = לתפוס שתי ציפורים במכה אחת. בדיוק כמו בעברית.
explanation.en: kill two birds with one stone = do two things with one action.

items.prompt: "He always says he'll help, but actions speak louder than words." What does the speaker mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

options.text: What you do matters more than words.
Actions make more noise than words.

hints.he: he says... but = הוא אומר, אבל...
hints.en: He says... but...

explanation.he: actions speak louder than words = מעשים חשובים יותר ממילים. בעברית: "לא המדרש עיקר אלא המעשה".
explanation.en: What you do shows more than what you say.

items.prompt: "Before the show, her friends told her, 'Break a leg!'" What did they mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.en: What do we say to an actor before a show?

explanation.he: break a leg = בהצלחה. אומרים את זה בעיקר לפני הופעה.
explanation.en: break a leg = good luck, before a performance.

items.prompt: "I hadn't heard from Ori for years, and then he called me out of the blue." What does this mean?

instruction.en: Choose what the expression means here

hints.he: hadn't heard for years = שנים לא שמעתי.
hints.en: No contact for years.

explanation.he: out of the blue = פתאום, משום מקום. בעברית: "כרעם ביום בהיר".
explanation.en: out of the blue = suddenly, unexpectedly.

lessons.goal: להבין מה זה phrasal verb ולזהות את המשמעות שלו מתוך ההקשר.

blocks.he: phrasal verb הוא פועל ועוד מילית קטנה (up, off, out, on...). יחד הם יוצרים משמעות חדשה, שלפעמים לא קשורה בכלל למילים עצמן. בעברית יש מעט צירופים כאלה, ובאנגלית יש מאות.

items.en: I gave up chocolate for a month.
Can you look after my cat?
She came up with a brilliant idea.

head: פועל
עם מילית
משמעות
rows: look after / look for / look up
turn on / turn off / turn down

blocks.wrong: Please pick up me at five.
blocks.right: Please pick me up at five.
blocks.he: כשהמושא הוא כינוי גוף (me, it, him), הוא בא בין הפועל למילית.
לא לתרגם מילה במילה. bring up a child זה לגדל ילד, לא להעלות אותו למעלה. כדאי ללמוד כל צירוף עם משפט דוגמה שלם.

lessons.goal: להבין משפטים מדוברים בעזרת מילים מודגשות וקיצורים נפוצים.

blocks.he: דוברי אנגלית לא אומרים כל מילה באותה עוצמה. המילים החשובות (שמות עצם, פעלים, מספרים, not) מודגשות וברורות. המילים הקטנות (a, the, to, of) נאמרות מהר ובשקט. לכן לא צריך לשמוע כל מילה כדי להבין.

items.en: I WANT to BUY a NEW PHONE.
items.he: המילים המודגשות לבדן כבר מספרות את הסיפור.

items.en: She DIDN'T come to the PARTY.

blocks.he: I'd + פועל בסיסי = I would. I'd + V3 = I had.
blocks.pattern: I'd like = I would like / I'd finished = I had finished

blocks.he: wanna כבר כולל את to, ולכן לא מוסיפים to אחריו.
can ו־can't נשמעות דומות. ב־can't התנועה ארוכה ומודגשת, וב־can היא קצרה וחלשה. כדאי לשים לב להדגשה.
לפני ההאזנה כדאי לקרוא את השאלה ולחשוב איזה מידע מחפשים: זמן? מקום? סיבה? ככה יודעים לאן להקשיב.
מילים כמו but, so, because, unless מסמנות את החלק החשוב. מה שבא אחרי but הוא בדרך כלל העיקר.
